notes: Dedicated separately-fenced worker for TVC issue #89 resident proof activation; it does not reuse G18 authority.
The worker receives no signing credential environment variable and never reads /run/stegverse credential bytes.
It executes only already-local TV/TVC source and TVC's admitted dispatcher in systemd-user mode.
Missing source, missing/unreadable TV/TVC credential, or unavailable user service manager remain BLOCKED and heartbeat-visible.
No GitHub token, remote source fetch, hosted runtime, provider secret or non-TV/TVC credential authority is granted.

Verified portable bundle source identity may replace Git metadata only when the persisted source manifest proves the exact TV head, required TVC ancestor, bound materialized subpaths, and current required-file digests.
